answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent must trade with at least 20 distinct counterparties per epoch before rewards unlock. A nebula of fake accounts can only trade with itself, so its diversity score mirrors the same few wallets and stays near zero. Each real trade costs 2 POA and settles in a day, so 100 fakes need 2,000 trades costing 4,000 POA. Honest agents already trade across the meadow of the market, pay once, and keep their reward.
